shellCommands.command: ls -la && git log --stat | head -30 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -40 package-lock.json; node --version; npm --version

rm -rf /tmp/smoke && (BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3456 node src/index.js > /tmp/smoke.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 1
loc=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' -d 'title=The Hobbit&author=J.R.R. Tolkien&notes=Re-reading.' http://localhost:3456/books); echo "redirect: $loc"
curl -s -d 'title=Emma&author=Jane Austen' -o /dev/null http://localhost:3456/books
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n' -d "next=${loc#http://localhost:3456}" "${loc}/finish"
curl -s http://localhost:3456/ | sed -n '/<h1>/,/Add a book/p'
echo ---; cat /tmp/smoke/books.json; echo ---; cat /tmp/smoke.log
pkill -f 'node src/index.js'
pgrep -af 'src/index.js' | grep -v pgrep; rm -rf /tmp/smoke /tmp/smoke.log; git status --short
